entities.name: Hosea
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prophet to the northern kingdom of Israel (c. 750–715 BCE) whose marriage to the unfaithful Gomer became a living parable of God's covenant love for wayward Israel. Themes of divine fidelity and restorative justice pervade his oracles.
